FlexScriptClass.name: Particles.Shape
FlexScriptClass.Summary: An enumeration of the emission region shapes, for shapeField. The region is sized by the emitter object's resize handles.

Property.name: Line
Property.Summary: Emit along a line (the object's X extent).

Property.name: Disk
Property.Summary: Emit from a filled ellipse in the object's footprint.

Property.name: Plane
Property.Summary: Emit from a filled rectangle (the object's footprint).

Property.name: Box
Property.Summary: Emit from anywhere within the object's 3D volume.

Property.name: Sphere
Property.Summary: Emit from within an ellipsoid volume (naturally omnidirectional; the aim arrow is hidden).
